author: Scott Eveland
text: The main differences are that the FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus sensor can be worn for up to 15 days (vs. 14 for the original 2), is compatible with insulin pumps, and is approved for children as young as two years old, while the FreeStyle Libre 2 is not compatible with pumps and is for those aged four and older. The "Plus" also offers improved accuracy, and while they look the same, the carton for the Plus model has the updated logo. some users have reported occasional connectivity issues or "signal loss" problems when using the FreeStyle Libre 2 (and 2 Plus) with Android phones, particularly with specific phone models or after certain Android operating system (OS) updates to the lastest ui 8.0 and OS 16. Abbott has acknowledged some of these issues and provides guidance to resolve them
